because: The stem asks which DO allows unfortified flor-aged Palomino. Equipo Navazos is a négociant bottler, not a DO or any legal territory, so this entry marks a non-answer as correct. The DO is Jerez-Xérès-Sherry, alongside Manzanilla-Sanlúcar de Barrameda. Unfortified Fino and Manzanilla at a natural minimum of 15% were admitted by the regulation changes that took effect on 10 October 2022 (SherryNotes, 'New regulations for sherry in the D.O. Jerez-Xérès-Sherry').
fix: accept: ["jerez", "jerez-xeres-sherry", "jerez unfortified", "manzanilla-sanlucar de barrameda", "sanlucar manzanilla pasto"] (drop "equipo navazos territory")
